name: @w6w-apps/monday
description: Boards, groups, items and columns on monday.com via its GraphQL API.

w6w.longDescription:
monday.com organizes work as boards of items moving through groups and columns, and this app puts that structure under workflow control: create and read boards, groups and items, and change an item's column values or move it between groups as work progresses.

Because monday's entire API is GraphQL rather than a set of REST endpoints, every action here is really a purpose-built query or mutation against the one endpoint monday exposes, so a workflow just supplies the ids and values that matter and never has to construct GraphQL itself. Column values are the part most likely to trip up a hand-built integration, since monday expects them as a specific encoded structure rather than plain values — this app validates and encodes them, so a workflow can pass a straightforward value and trust it lands correctly.

Archiving a board and deleting a group are included for cleanup, and looking up a board's own columns is there specifically to discover the ids a write needs before making one. This app stays at the level of boards and their contents — account and workspace administration aren't part of it.
